data.title: Orange skies in Indonesia as haze crisis spreads
data.description: PALANGKARAYA, Indonesia - Thick haze turned the skies in this Central Kalimantan city apocalyptic shades of yellow and orange on Thursday, reducing visibility to a few dozen metres as wildfires cause a regional air pollution crisis.

data.title: Pope has ‘good night’ in hospital, Vatican says
data.description: ROME - Pope Leo XIV had a “good night” in hospital and has eaten breakfast as he recovers from lung cancer surgery, the Vatican said Thursday.

data.title: California puts first US billionaire tax to a vote
data.description: LOS ANGELES - When Americans vote in next month’s midterm elections, one question on the ballot in California could echo far beyond the state: should the ultra-wealthy pay a special tax on their fortunes?

data.title: School headscarf ban meets resistance in Austria
data.description: VIENNA - As the new school year gets under way in Austria, a headscarf ban for girls under 14 has sparked protests on the streets and in the classroom, with dozens of pupils refusing to comply.

data.title: Costa Rica opens El Salvador-inspired mega-prison
data.description: ALAJUELA, Costa Rica - Costa Rica opened a high-security jail on Wednesday inspired by a mega-prison in El Salvador that has become a symbol of the country’s war on gangs, widely criticized by human rights groups.

data.title: New four-lane bridge opens between China, North Korea
data.description: DANDONG, China - A new four-lane road bridge linking China and North Korea finally opened on Thursday, 12 years late, enabling the Asian giant and its isolated nuclear-armed neighbour to step up cross-border trade substantially.

data.title: UN sounds alarm on growing poverty after Iran war shock
data.description: Millions could be thrown into poverty by surging energy costs, the impact of an intense El Nino phenomenon and higher interest rates, with vulnerable countries being pushed to the brink by repeated crises, says the United Nations’ development chief.

data.title: Australia fights ‘unfettered’ access to children by big tech
data.description: SYDNEY - Australia said on Thursday it refused to allow big tech to have “unfettered” access to its children as it formally introduced new legislation that would give users choice over what they see on their feeds.

data.title: Healthy corals help bleached neighbours recover, study finds
data.description: WASHINGTON - The world's coral reefs face an existential threat from rising seawater temperatures that trigger widespread bleaching, a problem driven by climate change and compounded by this year's intense El Nino phenomenon.

data.title: Behind AI’s carbon footprint, a powerful climate tool
data.description: Artificial intelligence has become a lightning rod in climate debates over concerns about the growing carbon footprint of the data centres powering the technology.

data.title: Prospect of Bolsonaro win looms large over Brazil's Indigenous
data.description: MANAUS (BRAZIL) - Brazil's Amazonian Indigenous communities are watching with bated breath as presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro inches closer to power, recalling the damage wrought on the rainforest under his father Jair Bolsonaro.

data.title: Oil-rich Alberta tests Canada’s unity with secession vote
data.description: Voters in Alberta decide next week if they want the oil-rich province to begin the process of separating from Canada, a pivotal test for the country as it confronts a hostile United States.

data.title: Indonesia rescues starved orangutan from fires
data.description: A female orangutan who was likely starving was evacuated on Wednesday from an area razed by fire on the Indonesian island of Borneo, officials said, as the country rescues hundreds of animals affected by the blazes.

data.title: In Chicago, pope's hometown, Catholics express shock and support
data.description: CHICAGO (UNITED STATES) - Priests and parishioners in Pope Leo XIV's hometown of Chicago expressed shock, support and hope Wednesday after doctors discovered that a nodule removed from his lung was cancerous.

data.title: US Treasury chief urges stronger IMF role against 'distortionary policies'
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called Wednesday for the IMF to do more in tackling "distortionary policies" that impact competition, a comment that appears directed at China.

data.title: Trump's new press secretary faces scrutiny over credentials
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - The White House was facing mounting questions Wednesday over new press secretary Katie Zacharia's legal credentials, after a faltering first day in the job when she gave an inconclusive answer about where she had passed the bar exam.
